name: Country sourdough
description: Our house loaf. Two-day ferment, a dark crust, and a soft, tangy crumb.

name: Seeded rye
description: Dense and dark, with sunflower, flax and caraway. Slices thin for toast.

name: Baguette
description: Crisp shell, open crumb. A second batch comes out at 11.

name: Rosemary focaccia
description: Olive oil, flaky salt, and rosemary from the garden out back.

name: Butter croissant
description: Three days of lamination with cultured butter. Shatters properly.

name: Almond croissant
description: Twice-baked with frangipane and toasted almonds.

name: Cardamom morning bun
description: Croissant dough rolled with cardamom and orange sugar.

name: Ham and gruyère
description: Smoked ham, aged gruyère and a little mustard, folded in croissant dough.

name: Plum and almond galette
description: Brown-butter rye crust, frangipane, and roasted plums.

name: Olive oil chocolate cake
description: Dark, damp and not too sweet, with a crackled top.

name: Lemon tart
description: Sharp lemon curd in a sweet short crust, brûléed to order.

name: Drip coffee
description: From a roaster two blocks away. Free refills while you sit.

name: Cappuccino
description: Double shot, whole or oat milk.

name: Hot chocolate
description: Melted dark chocolate and whole milk. That's all.
